sources.snippet: By inserting adapters into LLaMA's transformer, our method only introduces 1.2M learnable parameters, and turns a LLaMA into an instruction-following model within 1 hour. For stablizing training at early stages, we propose a novel Zero-init Attention with zero gating mechanism to adaptively incorporate the instructional signals.
